info.name: Itentio — Program Capacity & Invoice Reservation
info.description:
Backend-only service (no frontend) — tracks a financing program's credit capacity in real time. See README.md and docs/DECISIONS.md in the repo for the full write-up.

**Before you start:**
1. `docker compose up -d && npm run prisma:generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed`
2. `npm run start:dev` (http://localhost:3000)
3. Open the **`0 · Setup`** folder in this collection and read its description — the API has no endpoint to *create* a program (that's an intentional scope decision, see README/ADR), so you need one raw SQL insert before `reserve`/`release`/availability calls will work.
4. Run **`1 · Auth → Login`** once. Its test script captures both the access token and the refresh token into collection variables automatically — every other request inherits `accessToken` as a Bearer token.

Default seeded login: `admin@itentio.dev` / `dev-only-password-change-me` (role `ADMIN`).

**Since the last update:** `reserve`/`release` now require role `ADMIN` or `OPERATOR` (the seeded admin qualifies; a `READER`-role user gets 403 — see docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-017). `POST /auth/login` is rate-limited to 5 requests/minute — hitting it repeatedly while testing will start returning 429. Access tokens expire after 1h; use **`1 · Auth → Refresh token`** to get a new pair without re-sending the password (ADR-018) — it rotates the refresh token on every use, so the old one stops working immediately.

variable.description: Saved automatically by Login and by Refresh token's test scripts.
Must already exist — see the '0 · Setup' folder.
Fixed value used by the 'Reserve (idempotent replay demo)' request — send that request twice in a row to see the second call return the exact same response without creating a second reservation.

item.name: 0 · Setup
item.description:
The API deliberately exposes no endpoint to create a Program — that's an intentional scope decision (program creation is treated as back-office data entry, not part of the reserve/release/query surface; see README.md "Trying it out" and docs/DECISIONS.md). Create one directly in Postgres before using the requests below.

**Option A — psql (matches docker-compose.yml credentials):**
```
docker compose exec postgres psql -U itentio -d itentio -c "
INSERT INTO program (id, external_ref, name, currency_code, total_limit, updated_at)
VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'PRG-DEMO', 'Postman demo', 'GBP', '10000.00', now())
ON CONFLICT (external_ref) DO NOTHING;
"
```

**Option B — Prisma Studio:** `npx prisma studio`, open the `Program` table, add a row with `externalRef = PRG-DEMO`, `currencyCode = GBP`, `totalLimit = 10000.00`.

GBP, EUR, USD and JPY are already seeded as currencies by `npx prisma db seed`, so `PRG-DEMO` in GBP works out of the box. Change the `programRef` collection variable if you use a different external ref.

request.description: Seeded credentials from prisma/seed.ts (role ADMIN). Run this first — the test script stores both the access token and refresh token into collection variables. Rate-limited to 5 requests/minute — repeated wrong-password testing will start returning 429 before 401.

exec: pm.test('response has a new accessToken and refreshToken', function () {

request.description: Exchanges the refresh token for a new access+refresh pair — no password needed. Rotates on every use: the refresh token consumed here immediately stops working (docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-018), and the response's new refreshToken replaces it in the collection variable. Sending this request twice in a row with the same stored value will 401 the second time — that's expected, run Login again to get a fresh pair.
Returns { programRef, currency, totalLimit, reservedAmount, available } — amounts always as decimal strings (e.g. "1000.00"), never JSON numbers. Requires a Bearer token (401 without one).

header.description: A fresh UUID per send — normal usage. See the separate 'Reserve (idempotent replay demo)' request to see what happens when you reuse the same key.

request.description:
Reserves 100.00 GBP against PRG-DEMO for invoice {{invoiceRef}}. If the invoice currency differs from the program currency (try "amount": "50.00", "currency": "EUR"), the response's reservedAmount reflects the seeded FX rate applied and frozen at reservation time — see docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-003.

Change `invoiceRef` (collection variable, or edit the body directly) between calls if you want several independent reservations against the same program rather than re-hitting the same invoice.

header.description: Fixed value (collection variable) — send this request twice in a row.

request.description: Send this exact request twice in a row (same body, same Idempotency-Key). The second response is byte-identical to the first — no second reservation is created, and 'Get availability' won't show a second +25.00. This is the Idempotency-Key replay path (docs/DECISIONS.md — capacity.service.ts claimIdempotencyKey). To test it again later, either change the `idempotencyKey` collection variable to a new UUID, or change `invoiceRef` in the body — the business-key uniqueness on (program, invoice) is the durable guarantee that outlives the header's 24h TTL.

Releases the reservation made for {{invoiceRef}} — returns exactly the frozen amount to available capacity (zero FX drift, even if the invoice was in a foreign currency). Releasing an already-released invoice is a no-op, not an error.
The one deliberately unauthenticated endpoint — a liveness probe, not a business endpoint. Everything else in this collection requires the Bearer token from '1 · Auth → Login'.
